title: separateTypeDeclarations
responsibility: Separates generated interfaces and named type aliases into sibling type files, preserving type imports and exports.

inputs.name: separateTypeDeclarations.files
inputs.description: Scaffold files with paths and TypeScript source; generated type declarations are self-contained or use imported types.

outputs.name: separateTypeDeclarations
outputs.description: Planned implementation and sibling .types.ts files with type-only imports and compatibility exports; non-TypeScript and type-only files retain their contents.
